title: Project API port
responsibility: Define project requests shared by Web and native account clients without owning credentials or transport.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: API path, optional text query and optional JSON body. The transport supplies the current account session.

outputs.name: BrowserApi
outputs.description: JSON reads and writes, bounded media reads with MIME metadata, and byte reads.

outputs.name: ApiFailure
outputs.description: A failed request with an HTTP status and public error code.
